svg.title: Sagging Sheetflow / three real step approaches, two hypothetical roof datum solutions
svg.text: SAGGING SHEETFLOW / ABSOLUTE FLOOR AND ROOF DATUM
UNRELEASED ARCHITECTURAL OPTIONS: COMMON ROOF CROWN OR ONE-FOOT LIFT OVER A STEPPED BASALT BENCH

g.text: Brown: +1 ft bench. Red: three genuine traversable step edges.
02 / STEP 1 : 60 ft from north mouth to approach
All axes 24 px/foot; aligned floor and roof share z=0. Local profile of real dry passage.
Fixed: 5.5 ft clearance over bench. Lifted: 6.5 ft. Neither is a measured section.
03 / STEP 2 : 80 ft from north mouth to approach
All axes 24 px/foot; aligned floor and roof share z=0. Local profile of real dry passage.
Fixed: 5.5 ft clearance over bench. Lifted: 6.5 ft. Neither is a measured section.
04 / STEP 3 : 70 ft from north mouth to approach
All axes 24 px/foot; aligned floor and roof share z=0. Local profile of real dry passage.
Fixed: 5.5 ft clearance over bench. Lifted: 6.5 ft. Neither is a measured section.

svg.text: ARCHITECTURAL CONFLICT REVEALED, NOT SILENTLY RESOLVED
A one-foot higher floor under a continuous crown reduces clearance. Keeping 6.5 ft of local headroom requires the roof to rise.
Hypothetical fictional cave sections; no measured elevation, bearing, roof stability or certified accessible route.
